verdict.rationale: RustDesk's first-party docs say Server Pro provides a web console, device groups, a shared address book and per-user and device-group access control, which matches the story. The pricing page lists the same features, but this is limited to the commercial Server Pro tier, not the OSS server. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how group policies are defined and enforced, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the address book and group access control in practice.

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
Web console ... Address book ... Audit log ... Change ID ... Access control
